R. Austin Freeman, The D’Arblay Mystery.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/r-austin-freeman/the-darblay-mystery

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- R. Austin Freeman, the author, died 1943 (Wikidata Q2065950; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R._Austin_Freeman).

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'The D’Arblay Mystery was published in 1926 by R. Austin Freeman.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1926, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name one country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths. The last person to die, R. Austin Freeman, died in 1943, so the text enters the public domain in each of these countries on 1 January 2014. An unknown exact country, or simultaneous publication in two of them, changes nothing.
